prompt_en: A naturalistic location photograph of the reference-appearance protagonist: preserve the supplied reference's facial proportions, large dark eyes, softly rounded facial outline, and short dark bob with fine, separated bangs. The protagonist is visibly directing productive work on an agricultural estate, standing beside a newly finished circular stone threshing floor at the edge of harvested fields. The newly paved working yard is the quiet center of a first successful harvest after an estate improvement. She wears a dark green wool jacket over an open-collared cream linen shirt, practical dark trousers and worn boots. Her composed, attentive presence and softly luminous face give the scene a restrained human attraction; her attention belongs to the work. A foreman beside her holds a broad wooden plan board at waist level, tilted toward the camera; its simple diagram shows the same circular floor, straight drainage channel, and raised grain-store doorway seen behind them. Her right arm extends with a relaxed elbow, her index finger indicating the clear route from the threshing floor to that doorway. The foreman's gaze follows her hand toward the route. Both her boots stand firmly on the dry stone edge, and her other hand rests naturally at her side. On the floor, a worker draws a wooden rake through loose golden grain beside a compact pile of empty stalks. Farther along the indicated route, a second worker pushes a small handcart carrying full grain sacks up the shallow ramp into the open grain store; stacks of filled sacks are visible inside. A narrow stone-lined drain borders the dry paving and leads toward lower wet ground, making the practical improvement readable. An unbroken dirt-and-stone track runs from a small village beside the field edge, passes the threshing circle, and ends at the grain-store ramp below the estate hall. Both its village end and the store entrance remain in view. The moving sack cart and a second loaded two-wheel cart waiting beside the field occupy this same track, their wheels touching its surface. The hall stands uphill behind the store, distinct from the low working buildings. An eye-level three-quarter view from just outside the circle keeps the protagonist's face, pointing hand, plan board, threshing grain, cart route and grain-store opening legible together. Horizontal framing, a moderate wide lens and deep enough focus connect the near decision to the useful work behind it. Late autumn side light picks out chaff dust, cut stone and soft wool against darker damp earth. The people occupy believable space and continue their tasks in an unhurried, specific moment.
